about: Reviewed differences between a database and the reference built from the migrations, which verification accepts and always reports. Each entry is pinned to exact catalogue lines (supabase/ops/catalogue.sql): any other difference, a changed fingerprint, or an entry whose difference no longer exists makes verification fail. Change this file only through a reviewed pull request.

entries.reason: Migration 20261109000500 was run in the SQL Editor from Windows-format text, so this function body is stored with CRLF line endings. Outside string literals that is normalised; inside the multi-line dynamic SQL literal passed to execute format('update public.%I set verification_status = $1, ...') the three line breaks remain CRLF. Postgres treats CR as whitespace when it parses the executed SQL, so the function behaves exactly as the repository version. Checked on 2026-11-11 against the production verification report of 2026-11-10: production's raw body fingerprint f9239d98549576c343ba3d93ad8940e2 equals the repository text with every LF replaced by CRLF.
